name: breadcrumbs
title: Breadcrumbs
description: Shows where a page sits in a hierarchy, collapsing middle levels into a menu when long.

when: Pages nested two or more levels deep.

instead.when: One way back to the parent page is enough.
The levels are steps of a flow.

builtIn: A navigation landmark; the current page has aria-current.
youProvide: With children: a textValue on a Breadcrumb whose label is not plain text, for the folded menu.

genui.description: The path to the current page. items are {label, href?}; the last item is the current page.
